description: This file declares the AttachSamples class, which implements the IPlayerTask interface for attaching media samples (audio and video) to a media pipeline within a media player context. It includes data structures for audio and video sample data, and references external media pipeline and player context classes.

classes.name: AttachSamples
classes.description: A class responsible for attaching media samples (audio and video) to a media pipeline, implementing the IPlayerTask interface.

methods.name: AttachSamples
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the task with media context, player, and media segments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task of attaching media samples to the pipeline.
